creatures.name: Briarthorn Wolf
creatures.description: A wiry coastal wolf with bramble-tangled fur prowling the Whispering Grove.

creatures.name: Ruins Shield-Raider
creatures.description: A scrap-armored looter holding the front line with a dented buckler.

actions.name: Notched Hatchet
actions.description: Hacks over the rim of its dented buckler.

creatures.name: Ruins Stone-Slinger
creatures.description: A nimble skirmisher peppering foes from the backline behind the Shield-Raider.

actions.name: Sling Stone
actions.description: Whips a smooth river stone from the rear.

creatures.name: Cinder-Horn Sentinel
creatures.description: An ancient bronze-and-stone guardian set atop Beacon Cliff to test every proving recruit.

actions.name: Bronze Fist
actions.description: Brings a heavy bronze gauntlet crashing down.

actions.name: Cinder-Horn Flare
actions.description: Vents a scorching gust of beacon embers.
